subject: Discovery follow-up: scheduling demo / technical deep dive
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: John Perez <john.perez@acme.com>, Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@acme.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: scheduling demo / technical deep dive

Hi John / Aisha,

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through Acme's use case. Quick recap from our call:

- Primary goal: integrate a hosted LLM endpoint to power customer support summarization and routing (low-latency, PII controls).
- Key success metrics: 200ms median response, per-message cost target <$0.003, SOC2 evidence for audit.
- Technical constraints: redaction and KMS integration, EU-only storage for part of the workload.

Next step: schedule a 45-60 minute technical demo + integration deep dive where Stephanie (our Solutions Engineer) can walk through the runtime, routing, and security controls and answer your team's infra questions. Could you confirm which of the following times work for your team? All times are PT:

1) Tue, Sep 14, 10:00-11:00 AM PT
2) Tue, Sep 14, 2:00-3:00 PM PT
3) Wed, Sep 15, 9:00-10:00 AM PT

Also please confirm the attendee list and any specific areas you want us to focus on (e.g., KV cache, quantization, KMS/HSM integration). I'll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and a short agenda once you pick a slot.

Attachment: redwood_demo_agenda.pdf (PDF) - brief agenda / sample integration checklist.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0143
[redwood.ai]

Thanks for the clear recap. Tuesday, Sep 14 10:00-11:00 AM PT works for our team. Attendees I'll have on the call:

- John Perez (Product Lead)

Please include Stephanie from your side for the technical deep dive. We'll want to focus on: KMS integration, per-region data residency, and latency at scale.

If you can send calendar invite + Zoom link that would be perfect.

Thanks,
John

Hey Stephanie,

Thanks for being available. Quick note on focus for the call with Acme (Tue 10-11 AM PT):

- 10:00-10:30: Live demo of Redwood runtime focusing on latency and routing (show 200ms median in our benchmarks + how fallback routing works).
- 10:30-10:45: Deep dive on security: KMS/HSM integration, encryption-in-transit & at-rest, and retention controls (they mentioned SOC2 + EU data residency).
- 10:45-11:00: Integration Q&A: API keys, SDK examples, prefix/KV caching patterns, and deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs private).

If you can drop any troubleshooting or infra notes in the shared doc (link below) I can forward to them ahead of the call. Also please bring a short slide showing our recommended config for < 200ms at 50 rps.

Shared prep doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1PrepExample

Thanks - appreciate it.
Marissa
